sources.entry: Slime - App icon assets generator written in SwiftUI

summary.one_liner: Slime is a macOS SwiftUI app that generates app icon asset sets for iOS, watchOS, and macOS projects.
summary.what_it_does: Slime takes an icon image and produces an AppIcon.appiconset folder that can be dropped directly into an Xcode project. It lets you preview the generated assets before exporting them. It can export assets without an alpha channel and, as of version 2.0.0, batch-removes the alpha channel from PNG files. The README lists iOS, watchOS, and macOS as supported target platforms.
use_cases: generate app icon sets for Xcode
strip alpha channel from PNG icons
preview app icon sizes before export
notable: Exports a ready-to-use AppIcon.appiconset folder for Xcode
Batch removal of alpha channel from PNGs (added in 2.0.0)
Preview of generated assets before export
Covers iOS, watchOS, and macOS icon targets
caveats: README's 'How to Use' section is empty and gives no run instructions
Listed on the App Store, so a paid tier or store-only distribution is not ruled out by the README; not stated either way
